value.name: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences

facts.evidence: EECS Department: 'The Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering & Computer Sciences (EECS) requires 120 semester units over four years of full-time undergraduate study.'

value.notes: Nonresident Supplemental Tuition ($34,200) plus systemwide tuition and student services fees ($14,400) totaling approx. $48,600/year.

facts.evidence: UC Berkeley Financial Aid & Scholarships: Nonresident undergraduate supplemental tuition is $34,200 plus base tuition of $14,400 per academic year for 2025-2026.
facts.publisher: UC Berkeley Financial Aid and Scholarships Office

facts.value: Completion of secondary school with strong math (calculus) and physics. A-G subject pattern with minimum 3.4 GPA for non-residents. UC is test-free (no SAT/ACT used in admissions).
facts.evidence: UC Admissions: 'Out-of-state and international applicants must earn at least a 3.4 GPA with no grade lower than C in 15 college-preparatory courses.'
facts.publisher: UC Berkeley Office of Undergraduate Admissions

facts.value: TOEFL iBT 80 minimum (100+ strongly recommended for EECS); or IELTS Academic 6.5 minimum (7.0+ recommended); Duolingo English Test 115 minimum.
facts.evidence: UC Berkeley International Admissions: 'You must satisfy the English language requirement with a minimum score of 80 on the TOEFL or 6.5 on IELTS.'
facts.publisher: UC Berkeley Office of Undergraduate Admissions

facts.evidence: University of California Application: filing period October 1 through November 30 for Fall admission.

value.name: Master of Science in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

facts.evidence: MIT EECS Graduate Academics: 'Master of Science (SM) degree requires at least 66 credit units and submission of an acceptable thesis.'
facts.publisher: MIT Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

value.notes: Graduate base tuition $30,975 per term ($61,950 regular academic year).

facts.evidence: MIT Student Financial Services: Graduate regular tuition is $30,975 per semester ($61,950 for fall/spring) for 2025-2026.

facts.value: Accredited bachelor's degree in engineering or relevant scientific field, transcripts, statement of objectives, and 3 letters of recommendation. GRE is optional or not considered by EECS.
facts.evidence: MIT EECS Graduate Admissions Guide: requirements include bachelor's degree in relevant STEM discipline, statement of objectives, 3 recommendation letters.

facts.value: IELTS Academic minimum overall score of 7.0 (or TOEFL iBT minimum 100).
facts.evidence: MIT Graduate Admissions International applicants: IELTS minimum 7.0 or TOEFL 100 recommended for graduate study.
MIT EECS Admissions: 'The online application opens on September 15. The application deadline is December 15.'
School of Information: 'The Master of Science in Information (MSI) is a 48-credit full-time professional degree completed over two years.'
facts.publisher: University of Michigan School of Information

value.notes: Non-resident graduate tuition of $28,948 per semester ($57,896 per academic year of full-time enrollment).

facts.evidence: Office of the Registrar Tuition & Fees: Rackham / Information full-time non-resident tuition schedule is $28,948 per term.
facts.publisher: University of Michigan Office of the Registrar

facts.value: Accredited four-year bachelor's degree or international equivalent, transcripts, academic statement of purpose, personal statement, resume, and 3 recommendation letters.
facts.evidence: UMSI Admissions: 'Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution. Submission of resume, essays, and three letters required.'

facts.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall (with section cutoffs 25+) or IELTS Academic 7.0 overall (minimum 6.5 in all bands).
facts.evidence: Rackham Graduate School English Proficiency: 'Minimum score of 100 on the TOEFL or 7.0 on the IELTS for international applicants.'
UMSI Application Deadlines: Priority deadline for Master of Science in Information is January 15 for Fall enrollment.
